messages:
Sara Lin: quick pre-oncall heads-up — I'm taking the 22:00-06:00 shift tonight. Quick checklist: VPN, pager, runbooks, access to secret keys. If you can't cover, please ping now. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-prep
Alex M: got it. vpn connected, pd login ok. Ran `pd whoami` — shows alex@redwood. :white_check_mark:
Jamie C: I can't access /repos/infra/runbooks (403) — hitting this when trying to view the playbook for nightly handoffs
Priya S: Jamie — just re-added you to the org repos, should propagate in ~2m. Try `gh auth login` then `gh repo view redwood/infra`
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled infra maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC (us-west). Exporter restarts expected; watch metrics. This is informational only.
Sara Lin: noted. small risk: maintenance overlaps our morning ramp. If we see alert noise, escalate to infra. Also we should smoke-test pager + KMS + vault now. Suggest running the lightweight checks below:
```
# VPN
openvpn --config /etc/openvpn/redwood.ovpn
# PagerDuty
pd whoami
# KMS decrypt smoke
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode
```
Alex M: I'll run the tests in 30s. Also FYI — if you need to validate pager config without triggering alerts, use `pd event trigger --test` (doesn't create real incidents)
Jamie C: update: gh repo view works now, thanks @Priya S. Pager test passed — I saw the test ack come through and notification in mobile app. :thumbsup:
Priya S: I also added a short SSH bastion key rotation note to the ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ops/ssh-rotation.md — please skim before the shift
Sara Lin: thanks. final ask before I sign in at 21:50: if your pager/VPN/KMS aren't green, DM me ASAP and we'll swap. Backup tonight is @Priya S. I'll post a final handoff message at 21:50 with any outstanding context
Alex M: all set from my side (VPN, GH, PD, KMS validated). Good to go for night coverage
oncall-bot: Deployment scheduled: model-runtime v1.12 canary at 23:15 UTC. No manual action expected. If you observe >5% error rate, follow the rollback steps in the runbook.
